card.fact_statement: Thailand's Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation confirmed that the aftershocks on 31 March were too weak to affect Thailand.
card.answer: Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
card.source_span: While initially reported by some outlets as being due to aftershocks, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation confirmed that the aftershocks on 31 March were too weak to affect Thailand.
